sources.snippet: C-JEPA skips slot discovery (uses oracle positions). Real C-JEPA requires VideoSAUR/SAVi-style object-centric pretraining on top of visual features. V-JEPA 2-AC is a small block-causal, action/state-conditioned latent predictor, not Meta's 300M-parameter robot-action model; it preserves the teacher-forcing + rollout training shape.
